preconditions.description: The number of cities n must be between 2 and 100.
The number of roads m must be at least n - 1 to ensure the network is connected.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= vi <= n and 1 <= ui <= n and vi != ui for vi, ui in roads)
preconditions.description: Each road must connect two distinct cities within the range from 1 to n.

postconditions.description: The output must be the maximum possible value of the average number of safe roads among all shortest paths from the cultural capital to the main capital.
